title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, then keeps those whose workflows can run reproducibly offline. A builder-reviewer pipeline is used to construct difficulty-controlled tasks, spanning four task types, each with a reference solution and an executable verifier. With this pipeline, we build 6.8k environments and collect 19k verified successful trajectories for supervised finetuning. Finetuning on these trajectories improves LLMs of different families and sizes, from 2B to 122B paramet

translated_title: SkillGym：通过自动可验证环境生成训练技能使用智能体
translated_abstract: 技能为大语言模型智能体提供了完成长时程复杂任务所需的专业知识和指导。尽管技能在近期的智能体范式与框架中已被广泛采用，但如何合成可靠的训练数据以及如何训练智能体有效使用技能仍然缺乏探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了SkillGym，这是一个用于构建可验证环境、收集轨迹并训练技能使用智能体的自动化流水线。SkillGym首先从互联网上抓取大量技能，然后筛选保留那些工作流可在离线状态下可重复运行的技能。通过构建者-审查者流水线来构建难度可控的任务，涵盖四种任务类型，每种任务都配有参考解决方案和可执行的验证器。借助这一流水线，我们构建了6.8千个环境，并收集了1.9万条经验证的成功轨迹用于监督微调。在这些轨迹上进行微调可以提升不同家族和规模的大语言模型表现，参数规模覆盖从2B到122B……
tldr: SkillGym提出了一个自动化流水线，通过从互联网抓取可离线复现的技能、构建带可执行验证器的难度可控任务环境，并收集大量经验证的成功轨迹进行微调，有效提升了从2B到122B参数的各类大语言模型的技能使用能力。
